title: Trump’s Data Center Gamble: Why Voters Are Turning Against the AI Boom in 2026 Midterms
description: President Trump champions data centers as economic engines and national security necessities in the AI race. Voters across party lines increasingly reject them over soaring electricity costs, water use and community disruption. As midterms near, even Republican governors impose restrictions, creating a widening rift with the White House. This backlash could reshape key races from Ohio to Texas.
